name: Pengput Biomedical Informatics Lab
tagline: Evidence Synthesis | Biomedical Ontology | AI | Digital & Population Health
description: Pengput Biomedical Informatics Lab connects evidence synthesis, biomedical ontology, artificial intelligence, digital health, and population health research to build practical, data-informed solutions for communities.
aboutDescription: Pengput Biomedical Informatics Lab brings together researchers, students, and collaborators to conduct evidence synthesis and develop trustworthy health data, ontologies, AI, and digital tools for digital and population health.

focusAreas.title: Biomedical Informatics & Evidence Synthesis
focusAreas.description: Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, research literacy, and data-informed methods for public and population health.

focusAreas.title: Biomedical Ontology & AI
focusAreas.description: Knowledge representation, formal ontologies, artificial intelligence, and semantic methods for health research.

focusAreas.title: Digital & Population Health
focusAreas.description: Health information systems, epidemiological informatics, and practical digital tools for communities and health workers.
